# Dario Casertano — Senior Full Stack Engineer
> Distributed systems, AI agents, industrial automation. Full stack across backend, frontend and real-time — from design to deployment. 15+ years of experience.

- [Territorial management platform](https://casertano.name/progetti/piattaforma-gestione-territoriale/): System for organizations with branches, shifts and resources

- [KeyPlex](https://casertano.name/progetti/keyplex/): Open-source npm library for namespaced key-value storage
- [LicensePluginJson](https://casertano.name/progetti/license-plugin-json/): Vite/Rollup plugin generating JSON license reports
